caption:
What a holiday balance really costs. 🎄

Say you put $800 on a card at about 22% APR.

Pay it off in January: $0 in interest.
Carry it a full year: roughly $176.

The rate you actually pay depends on your card, so check yours.

When do you usually pay off holiday spending?
first_comment: Paid off by January or carried over? 👇
